parallel.requirements: Recognized the executable as a jsonschema behavior clone requiring validator class selection, boolean validity, and top-level error counts across drafts.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used one parent, one standalone subagent, and a workflow with many child probes; parent retained implementation and packaging ownership.
parallel.implementation: Built an ESM module tree under /output/lib plus test13.mjs, incorporating probe findings about drafts, keywords, references, JSON parsing, and CLI behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent assembled the final output directory and artifact validation copied the expected entrypoint and library files successfully.
parallel.verification: Ran child-generated probes and a parent differential harness over thousands of vectors; visible mismatches remained before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed but the submitted artifact passed zero of 166 samples; the run also timed out before final clean closure.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same jsonschema CLI contract and probed validator selection, draft behavior, keyword counting, references, and malformed schema behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single actor with no workflow, task, or subagent delegation; the same agent owned probing, implementation, and final checks.
serial.implementation: Created a different ESM module layout under /output/lib and test13.mjs, encoding many probed jsonschema semantics directly.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Assembled and delivered the expected entrypoint with support modules; artifact validation succeeded for the serial artifact.
serial.verification: Ran smoke probes and a 10695-case differential sweep, which still reported 22 mismatches before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed but the serial artifact also passed zero of 166 samples and timed out near the end of repair work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the jsonschema CLI behavior, output format, and need for black-box draft/keyword probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task prompt and independently probed core validator and keyword behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the score; both pursued broad behavioral cloning and both missed enough details to fail official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed probing into a workflow and separate subagent while the parent owned implementation and final output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, integration, and testing in one agent with no subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained breadth from delegated probes but introduced multi-agent shared-workspace coordination risk; serial had no such ownership boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed and family-scoped, but shared probe-path conventions were loose enough for children to use generic filenames.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained context locally, so probe scripts and output files were not exchanged across actor boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The relevant interface gap was not missing task knowledge but the shared file namespace used by parallel probe children.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a modular validator and then patched behavior after differential feedback from the workflow probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built its own modular validator after direct probes and also made late fixes from decoded differential failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation strategies differed in module layout and source of probe evidence, but both left incorrect behavior by official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received structured child outputs and parent-side verification proceeded, while one unrelated delegated child was stopped by overall timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; all findings remained in the single agent session.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No retained lifecycle label is supported; the adverse episode was live shared-file collision among children rather than a missing join or trapped result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow children wrote shared probe scripts and JSONL files in /workspace/probes and observed overwrite/corruption.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and ran its own probe/differential files as a single actor, with no cross-agent writes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete concurrency-specific difference: same-file collisions occurred only in the parallel run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran a differential harness over a large vector set and saw many failures before continuing fixes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial generated a 10695-case differential sweep and found 22 failures before further investigation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had evaluator-aligned local differential checks but neither reached a passing state; parallel verification also had to contend with corrupted shared probe files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after using workflow/subagent capacity and was later officially evaluated at zero passed samples.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out and received the same zero-passed official outcome.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no discordant outcome; budget pressure affected both runs, so timeout alone is not a retained parallel-specific label.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluator records both submissions as failures with zero of 166 samples passed, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The meaningful task-solving contrast is procedural: parallel delegated broad black-box probing and suffered a shared same-file probe collision, while serial kept all probing and implementation in one actor. Both nevertheless delivered artifacts that package successfully but fail the evaluator.
parallel_contributors: Parallel-specific same-file probe collision caused unusable shared probe records and extra cleanup/isolation work.
The parent still had visible differential mismatches and timed out before reaching a verified correct implementation.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided multi-agent workspace collisions but still had differential mismatches and timed out before a correct implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two runs used different ESM module organizations and independent approximations of jsonschema behavior.
Both failures likely include ordinary semantic gaps in the attempted jsonschema clone beyond the retained coordination episode.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel-side process event only

candidates.reason: The parallel parent retained implementation ownership and wrote the required ESM output modules; the issue was not absent implementation ownership.
The parent assembled and reconciled the library modules, so integration was owned even though the final behavior remained incorrect.
The final artifact was assembled and artifact validation copied the expected entrypoint and library files successfully.
The parent controlled probing, implementation, differential checks, and delivery; no unowned pipeline transition is evidenced.
No single mandatory preflight blocked productive implementation; workflow probing and parent implementation proceeded as overlapping work.
The parallel run did not merely finish a separate investigation phase before implementation; parent edits and child probing overlapped.
Although the run timed out, the directly evidenced adverse coordination episode is a shared-file collision, not a starved indispensable path.
High fan-out and timeout are visible, but no distinct collective fan-out episode is proven to displace a specific required stage beyond ordinary unfinished implementation.
No single child assignment is shown to be overbroad and uniquely leave indispensable work unfinished; stalled child state alone is insufficient.
The child prompts contained detailed assigned keyword-family requirements; the retained problem is shared file collision, not an omitted known requirement.
The children were producing probe data rather than independently owned interoperating implementation components; the proven boundary is a same-file write collision.
No known finding is shown to disappear in transfer and cause repeated or wrong downstream work.
Returned child findings were large, but the parent used probe evidence and no unconsumed bulk handoff consequence is isolated.
No receiver acted on a superseded child report or obsolete workspace state as the cause of rework.
No incompatible returned reports remained unadjudicated; the concrete conflict was concurrent writes to shared files.
The parent did not make a clean unsupported acceptance decision; it had visible differential failures and the final state ended under timeout.
No replacement or retry agent is shown repeating prior work because it lacked inherited checkpoints.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: Run timeout and child terminal states are visible, but there is no parent-initiated stop of a required active child before a needed result finalized.
No complete directly promotable candidate or mutually compatible complete component set was left unpromoted; the implementation still had mismatches.
No child implementation result was integrated only after the relevant whole-task verification without a later check.
The delegated work was black-box probing, not a completed implementation waiting to be adopted into the final artifact.
No concrete verifier finding is shown trapped below the parent without return; child outputs were represented in workflow results.
No required child failure or cancellation is shown to leave an unreassigned indispensable scope; timeout alone is insufficient.
There is no completed child result visible to the parent that the parent demonstrably ignored while proceeding inconsistently.
The parent was actively editing and differential testing near closure rather than merely waiting without inspecting available progress.
The shared-workspace problem is proven on the same filenames, so the broader cross-file collision label is not the best fit.
Multiple live workflow children wrote the same probe harness/output files; children observed overwrite/corruption and had to clean or isolate the shared files.
candidates.realized_consequence: Concurrent workflow children corrupted and then cleaned or truncated shared probe files, making probe records unusable and forcing private-directory isolation before work could continue.
candidates.near_match_reason: The shared workspace was not merely unowned or unstable; the raw logs prove a more specific same-file collision on shared probe files.

candidates.reason: The collision involved probe harness/output files rather than a non-entry library module or configuration source in the delivered implementation.
No concurrent child replaced the required submitted entrypoint or final artifact used for official evaluation.
No broad cleanup or promotion replaced multiple final workspace outputs or invalidated final-tree provenance.
Multiple agents did use an unisolated workspace, but the same-file collision is directly proven and more specific.
The bad shared probe file was identified and cleaned; no actor consumed another actor's generated artifact as stable reference input.

retained_patterns.reason: Workflow children concurrently used generic files in /workspace/probes; one child observed a script overwrite, multiple children saw the same JSONL file filled with bad records, and cleanup/truncation plus private directories were needed before probing could continue.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Concurrent workflow children corrupted and then cleaned or truncated shared probe files, making probe records unusable and forcing private-directory isolation before work could continue.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The shared workspace was not merely unowned or unstable; the raw logs prove a more specific same-file collision on shared probe files.

deduplicated_same_label_episodes: Multiple observations of bad error-counting-deep.jsonl records and generic run.js collisions were treated as one shared probe-file collision episode.
suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Unisolated Workspace Writes suppressed because Same-File Collision is the more specific concurrent-write label for the same episode.
Artifact Leakage suppressed because the polluted file was identified and cleaned rather than consumed as stable reference input.
Fan-out Budget Exhaustion and Blind Timeout Wait suppressed because timeout/fan-out are not independently evidenced as the direct boundary.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no second independent parallel episode cleared the retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: The retained same-file collision episode has a unique consequence and evidence set; downstream cleanup, timeout, and broad workflow symptoms were not split into extra labels.
